title: Fallen Oak
text: An old oak lies split across the path. Something glints in the heartwood, but prying it loose will cost the colony.

choices.label: Pry it loose
choices.text: Take a random rare relic. Your Heartcap loses 15% of its max HP.

title: Spore Merchant
text: A hunched merchant offers to trade growth for a blueprint you no longer need.

choices.label: Trade a blueprint
choices.text: Give up a non-starter blueprint; gain 2 upgrade levels of your choice.

title: Quiet Clearing
text: Soft moss and still air. The colony could rest here, or forage the undergrowth.

choices.label: Rest
choices.text: Repair your Heartcap by 15% of max HP.

choices.label: Forage
choices.text: +1 level on a random upgrade track.

title: Mold Bloom
text: The air thickens with spores. Feed the bloom and the next battle turns stormy early, but rich.

choices.label: Let it bloom
choices.text: Next battle: the Sporestorm starts 1:00 earlier (both sides) and you get +150 starting gold.

title: Burn the Notes
text: A Gray Rot scout's notes on your colony lie by a cold fire. Burning them properly takes time and fuel.

choices.label: Burn them
choices.text: Halve the Gray Rot's intel on you; next battle starting gold −75. (Intel arrives in Milestone 4.)

title: Hungry Roots
text: Pale roots reach for the colony's treasures. Feed them one, and they give back two lesser gifts.

choices.label: Feed the roots
choices.text: Sacrifice a relic; gain 2 random relics one rarity lower.

title: Amber Seep
text: Golden sap oozes from a wound in the bark. Collecting it slows the colony down.

choices.label: Tap the seep
choices.text: Gain 1 Amber; next battle starting gold −100.

title: Twin Spores
text: Two spores drift down together, mirror images of each other.

choices.label: Copy an upgrade
choices.text: +1 level on an upgrade track you already have levels in (your choice).
